notes.title: Difficulty details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/02ef4691a7962c9f5e4e74ae8f0311d3b44611a6.png[/img]
There is now a button under the difficulty option which opens a window where you can see the difference between the difficulties if you want.

It makes easier to find the best difficulty for you.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/29d740061d99e85011d3cc23ae539c507f44b8cd.png[/img]
You can display the parameter:

[list]
[*] Health
[*] Damage
[*] Zombie amount (monsters per level)
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/a3da942f2b5a4bee171126ca5a9c6a833e8f49d7.png[/img]
In Health and Damage, you can switch between the different enemies (monsters) and display their own parameters.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Arena
notes.content:
[h1]New map available![/h1]

[h2]Can be played with up to 8 players.[/h2]
Survive as many levels as possible in a confined space of an arena with no unlockable map parts. Everything is available on the first level!

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Now available!
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyːWe're very excited to announce that Village of Zombies is now available on Steam!

[h3]information on the game:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772720/Village_of_Zombies/
[hr][/hr]
Up to four players can play together, each game starts in the lobby area where you can wait for more players until the host starts the game. However, players can also join games that have already started. You have the option to play alone (offline) or online with friends. But it is also possible to set the host settings to public. So any player can join at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/c50132dec744e7351a3fd4aa6c178eebe27b68e7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Livestream #2
notes.content:
[h3]information on the demo:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772720/Village_of_Zombies/
[hr][/hr][h3]Online Co-op[/h3]
Up to four players can play together, each game starts in the lobby area where you can wait for more players until the host starts the game. However, players can also join games that have already started. You have the option to play alone (offline) or online with friends. But it is also possible to set the host settings to public. So any player can join at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/c50132dec744e7351a3fd4aa6c178eebe27b68e7.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Characters[/h3]
It's a third-person shooter with multiple characters to choose from. Before starting or joining a game, you have the option to choose a character from a list to play with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/805b4c3a1d51d668ea6cd43f14696d924413cd90.png[/img]

[hr][/hr][h3]Map[/h3]
The map "Village" will be available in the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/8f92d283a882255815b377d79873d52f8d794904.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[i]Unfortunately there were technical difficulties with the transmission of the first Livestream. We hope it works this time. Please excuse the inconvenience.[/i]
